candidates.title: Enterprise Zones
candidates.description: The Maryland Department of Commerce (COMMERCE) identifies and maintains boundaries where business may be eligible for income tax and real property tax credits for job creation and investments. Businesses may be eligible for the following tax credits: real property tax credits and income tax credits.

Businesses in an Enterprise Zone Focus Area may be eligible for real property tax credits, personal property tax credits and income tax credits.
